title: Program topology and G0 definition
objective: Encode the authorized roadmap, dependency graph, immutable G0 criteria, and honest bootstrap construction record
acceptance_summary: The P0 through P3 program graph is acyclic and records deferred contract materialization
G0 has exactly fourteen immutable criteria and no worker-supplied results
Generated gate documentation has one machine-readable source
The construction log does not imply that bootstrap work ran under the control plane
